inputs.title: Scenario inputs
inputs.scenarioHint: Example assumptions, not forecasts. Edit the rate to use your own.

growth.hint: Change anything; the numbers follow immediately.
growth.paidInVsGrowthHint: Stacked, so the part that is your money and the part that is the assumed return stay distinguishable.
growth.threeRates: The same plan at three rates
growth.threeRatesHint: One assumption changed, everything else held.

goal.title: Goal and assumptions
goal.hint: Every figure below follows from these.
goal.pathHint: The target is drawn as a reference line.
goal.matrixHint: The same goal under each named assumption. Every cell comes from the engine.
goal.noGoals: No goals set yet. A goal gives a scenario something to be measured against.

dividend.actualHint: Recorded payments, net of tax and fees. Nothing on this row is projected.
dividend.hint: Assumptions you choose, applied to the future.

whatIf.hint: Nothing here touches your portfolio. Reset discards the whole scenario.
whatIf.excludedNoRate: Excluded for want of a rate
whatIf.empty: No open positions to model. Record a transaction first.

stress.matrixHint: The same portfolio under a series of falls. Each row is a full calculation, not the first row scaled — cash does not fall, so the relationship is not proportional.
stress.buildHint: Add assumptions. Where two of them reach the same holding they compound, and each one's own effect is listed below.
stress.decompositionHint: Each assumption's effect on top of the ones before it, in the order applied. The parts add up to the whole exactly.
stress.byPositionHint: Only holdings the scenario moved, largest impact first.
stress.assumedHint: Read the figures above only with these.
stress.historical: Worst fall this portfolio has been through
stress.historicalHint: Measured on its own return history, with money paid in and taken out removed — so a deposit was never mistaken for a recovery.
stress.needsHolding: Stress testing needs at least one holding to restate.
stress.needsPercentage: Set a percentage on at least one assumption to see a result.

reasons.INVALID_INITIAL_VALUE: Enter a starting value of zero or more.
reasons.INVALID_CONTRIBUTION: Enter a contribution of zero or more.
reasons.INVALID_RETURN: Enter an annual return between −100% and 1000%.
reasons.INVALID_DURATION: Enter a duration between 1 and 50 years.
reasons.NO_FX_RATE: No exchange rate is available for this currency.
reasons.INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY: There is not enough history to base this assumption on.
